about_the_game:
Persimmon is a movement-based 3D metroidvania stylized like an ancient Korean painting... featuring a jetpack!

Sunny has just stepped off the train in Chinatown, Seattle... but something's off. This fantastical parallel world is full of twisting, mazelike rooms which demand mastery of platforming and jetpack-assisted flight. Through her ensuing adventure, she, along with you, will discern why she's here, where she's come from, and how she can find peace from her turbulent past.

Featuring...

  • Top-notch 3D precision platforming - easy to learn, difficult to master!

  • A maze-like Metroidvania world to navigate and explore.

  • A richly stylized, painterly art style resembling the legendary artwork of the Joseon era.

  • A slowly-unraveling, heartfelt story about a young woman's reconnection with her heritage and humanity.

  • A cool-as-heck jetpack!

Wishlist Persimmon and fly into this magnificent adventure at the game's release!
